mechanism: 64 KiB provides four physical 16 KiB RAM segments. The current startup assumes at least eight and masks readback with 7. Its selected logical map segment 0 aliases the physical Page3 segment: the first map copy overwrites D000 interrupt vectors and the stack. Display was disabled for cold loading and is never restored. In the matched 128 KiB case all selected segments are distinct and start/movement succeed.
limitations: Reproduction in openMSX 21.0 with contributor-supplied BIOS, not a readback of the actual multicart or a physical test with RAM expansion.
The user reported FS-FX; FS-A1FX is the assumed equivalent model used for reproduction. The confirmed 64 KiB original RAM is insufficient independently of exact model naming.
No claim of 64 KiB compatibility. Cartridge Flash capacity and ASCII16 bank selection do not provide the system RAM mapper required by this build.
The production ROM has no minimum-RAM refusal screen; the host launcher rejects insufficient RAM, but direct cartridge startup currently does not.
